about.en: Bridge2 is Hyperliquid's USDC bridge contract on Arbitrum. A withdrawal is signed on Hyperliquid and paid out on Arbitrum by validators; the contract's FinalizedWithdrawal event carries the Hyperliquid user and the withdrawal nonce, which Hyperliquid's ledger also reports for the withdrawal. The key covers withdrawals only, with the user as a lower-case 0x address. Deposits are plain USDC transfers to the bridge and share the Arbitrum transaction hash instead.
